title: Loaded Mac And Cheese
blurb: A full pound of bacon and two cheeses go into the base, then a panko-parmesan crust keeps the top from going soft the way foil-covered mac and cheese always does.

ingredients.note: divided — diced for the pasta, melted for the topping

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Spray a 9×13 baking dish with nonstick spray.
Cook the macaroni in a large pot of boiling, salted water until al dente, then drain. Return it to the pot and stir in two-thirds of the butter, diced, until melted and coating the pasta.

Whisk together the eggs, evaporated milk, hot sauce, salt, pepper, dry mustard, smoked paprika and garlic powder in a bowl. Stir the egg mixture into the pasta, then stir in the gruyere, cheddar, bacon and scallions. Cook over low heat, stirring, about 3 minutes, until creamy.
Scrape the mixture into the prepared baking dish and smooth into an even layer.
Combine the panko, the remaining butter, melted, and the parmesan in a small bowl and sprinkle evenly over the top.
Bake, uncovered, on the top rack for 15 to 20 minutes, until golden brown on top.
